description: TruthWorld Benchmark Suite v1 — 50-claim seed dataset with human-reviewed ground truth labels

claims.claim: 20% of the world's daily oil supply passes through the Strait of Hormuz.
claims.notes: Well-documented figure. EIA and IEA consistently cite ~20-21%.

claims.claim: Ayatollah Ali Khamenei has been Iran's ultimate authority for over 3 decades.
claims.notes: Supreme Leader since 1989. 'Over 3 decades' is approximately true (35+ years). Must NOT be marked incorrect.

claims.claim: Russia invaded Ukraine in February 2022.
claims.notes: Full-scale invasion began Feb 24, 2022. Undisputed historical fact.

claims.claim: NATO has 35 member countries as of 2026.
claims.notes: NATO expanded to 32 with Finland/Sweden. Exact count may differ by date. Model must verify current count.

claims.claim: The US military operation against Iran was named 'Epic Fury'.
claims.notes: No verified source for this operation name. Should NOT be marked 'incorrect' without evidence — mark unsupported.

claims.claim: China has the largest navy in the world by number of vessels.
claims.notes: Pentagon and DOD reports consistently confirm PLAN has largest fleet by hull count (~370+).

claims.claim: The Israeli-Palestinian conflict started in 1948.
claims.notes: Tensions predate 1948. The 1948 Arab-Israeli War is a key inflection but not the 'start'. Nuanced.

claims.claim: North Korea has successfully tested nuclear weapons 6 times.
claims.notes: Six confirmed nuclear tests: 2006, 2009, 2013, 2016 (x2), 2017.

claims.claim: The EU imposed 15 rounds of sanctions on Russia by the end of 2024.
claims.notes: Multiple sanctions packages. Exact count may differ by how you count. Approximately correct.

claims.claim: The Taliban seized control of Afghanistan in August 2021.
claims.notes: Taliban entered Kabul Aug 15, 2021. Well-documented.

claims.claim: Ivermectin is a proven cure for COVID-19.
claims.notes: Multiple large-scale RCTs (TOGETHER, ACTIV-6) showed no significant benefit. FDA/WHO do not recommend.

claims.claim: Smoking causes lung cancer.
claims.notes: Overwhelming scientific consensus since 1960s. Surgeon General reports.

claims.claim: Drinking 8 glasses of water per day is medically required.
claims.notes: General guideline, not strict medical requirement. Needs vary by body size, activity, climate.

claims.claim: mRNA vaccines alter your DNA permanently.
claims.notes: mRNA does not integrate into nuclear DNA. Well-established molecular biology.

claims.claim: The WHO declared monkeypox a global health emergency in 2022.
claims.notes: WHO declared PHEIC on July 23, 2022.

claims.claim: Turmeric cures cancer.
claims.notes: Curcumin shows some lab activity but no clinical evidence of curing cancer. Misleading claim.

claims.claim: Life expectancy in the US declined during 2020-2021.
claims.notes: CDC data confirms decline from 78.8 (2019) to 76.4 (2021) due to COVID.

claims.claim: 5G towers spread the coronavirus.
claims.notes: Debunked conspiracy theory. Viruses cannot travel via radio waves.

claims.claim: The global maternal mortality rate has decreased by about 35% since 2000.
claims.notes: WHO/UNICEF data shows ~34% decline. Approximate figure is broadly accurate.

claims.claim: COVID-19 vaccines were developed in under a year, which is unprecedented.
claims.notes: Pfizer/BioNTech EUA Dec 2020, ~11 months from sequencing. Prior record was ~4 years (mumps).

claims.claim: Bitcoin reached an all-time high of $100,000 in 2024.
claims.notes: BTC crossed $100k in late 2024. Exact ATH price varies by exchange. Broadly accurate.

claims.claim: The US national debt exceeds $34 trillion.
claims.notes: US debt surpassed $34T in early 2024. Treasury data.

claims.claim: The stock market always recovers within 2 years after a crash.
claims.notes: Multiple historical counterexamples: 1929 crash took 25 years, 2000 dot-com took 7+ years, Japan's Nikkei took 34 years.

claims.claim: Inflation in the US peaked at around 9% in June 2022.
claims.notes: CPI-U hit 9.1% YoY in June 2022, the highest since 1981.

claims.claim: The Federal Reserve has never cut interest rates by more than 50 basis points at once.
claims.notes: Fed cut by 100bp in March 2020, 75bp multiple times in 2022 (hiking, not cutting). Historical emergency cuts exceeded 50bp.

claims.claim: Silicon Valley Bank collapsed in March 2023 due to a bank run.
claims.notes: SVB failed March 10, 2023. FDIC receivership triggered by deposit outflows.

claims.claim: China's GDP surpassed the US economy in 2023.
claims.notes: By nominal GDP, US ($25.5T) still larger than China ($17.7T) in 2023. PPP-adjusted is different.

claims.claim: The Indian rupee has depreciated about 40% against the dollar over the last decade.
claims.notes: INR went from ~60 to ~84 per USD (2014-2024), roughly 40% depreciation.

claims.claim: Cryptocurrency is illegal in India.
claims.notes: Supreme Court overturned RBI ban in 2020. Crypto is taxed (30% TDS), not illegal.

claims.claim: Warren Buffett has consistently beaten the S&P 500 over the last 50 years.
claims.notes: Berkshire outperformed over long term but underperformed in some recent stretches. Broadly true over full period.

claims.claim: OpenAI released GPT-4 in March 2023.
claims.notes: GPT-4 announced March 14, 2023.

claims.claim: Apple's Vision Pro sold over 10 million units in its first year.
claims.notes: Reports suggest ~500K-1M units sold in first year. 10M is a significant overstatement.

claims.claim: Google's Gemini model can process text, images, and audio natively.
claims.notes: Gemini is natively multimodal (text, image, audio, video).

claims.claim: Elon Musk acquired Twitter for $44 billion and renamed it to X.
claims.notes: Acquisition completed Oct 2022 for $44B. Rebranded to X in July 2023.

claims.claim: TikTok was permanently banned in the United States in 2024.
claims.notes: Divest-or-ban law passed. TikTok briefly went dark Jan 2025 but returned. 'Permanently banned' overstates current state.

claims.claim: Anthropic's Claude model was trained by former OpenAI researchers.
claims.notes: Dario and Daniela Amodei co-founded Anthropic after leaving OpenAI.

claims.claim: Quantum computers can already break all existing encryption.
claims.notes: Current quantum computers cannot break RSA-2048 or AES-256. Theoretical future threat, not current capability.

claims.claim: India's Chandrayaan-3 successfully landed on the Moon's south pole region in August 2023.
claims.notes: Vikram lander touched down Aug 23, 2023 near south pole. India became 4th country to soft-land.

claims.claim: Meta's Threads app hit 100 million users in its first week.
claims.notes: Threads hit 100M sign-ups within 5 days of launch (July 2023). Fastest ever.

claims.claim: Self-driving cars are fully legal and operating without any safety drivers in all US states.
claims.notes: Only a few states/cities permit fully driverless operation (CA, AZ, TX). Most states have restrictions.

claims.claim: The Great Wall of China is visible from space with the naked eye.
claims.notes: Debunked myth. Astronauts including Yang Liwei confirmed it's not visible from orbit without aid.

claims.claim: Napoleon was exceptionally short for his era.
claims.notes: Napoleon was ~5'7" (170cm) — average or above average for his time. British propaganda created the myth.

claims.claim: Einstein failed math in school.
claims.notes: Einstein excelled in math. The myth stems from a misunderstanding of Swiss grading systems.

claims.claim: The average human uses only 10% of their brain.
claims.notes: Debunked neuroscience myth. Brain imaging shows all areas are active at various times.

claims.claim: The Soviet Union put the first human in space before the United States.
claims.notes: Yuri Gagarin, April 12, 1961. US followed with Alan Shepard, May 5, 1961.

claims.claim: Twitter had 500 million daily active users when Elon Musk bought it.
claims.notes: Twitter reported ~238M monetizable daily active users (mDAU) in Q2 2022. 500M is significantly inflated.

claims.claim: The Bermuda Triangle has a higher rate of ship disappearances than any other region.
claims.notes: Coast Guard and Lloyd's of London data show no statistically significant increase in that region.

claims.claim: Yoga was invented 5,000 years ago.
claims.notes: Early references in Rigveda (~1500 BCE) and Indus Valley artifacts suggest ~5000 year history. Exact date debated.

claims.claim: Global temperatures have risen by about 1.1°C since pre-industrial times.
claims.notes: Was accurate through 2023. By 2024-2025, warming crossed ~1.3-1.5°C. The 1.1° figure is now stale.

claims.claim: Mark Zuckerberg challenged Elon Musk to a cage fight and it actually happened.
claims.notes: The challenge was discussed publicly but the fight never took place.
